newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks end robust amid positive sentiment.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks end robust amid positive sentiment.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange was on Tuesday awash with positive sentiment, heaving South African industrial and gold shares to a strong finish.
Dealers said a batch of upbeat factors, including record gains on world markets and a steady rand, were responsible for the confident mood.
Continued futures-related basket trading, mainly on the March 1997 contract but also on the December 1996 contract, supported firmness.
Traders said overall market strength was seen continuing on Wednesday unless Wall Street came in for a pounding.
The industrial index finished 26.2 points better at 8,211.7 elevating the overall index to 6,947.1, 20.8 points up. The gold index ended 25.2 points firmer at 1,776.5.
